units.zh: 天福八年秋七月丁丑朔，京師雨水深三尺。
units.en: On the first day dingchou of the seventh month of autumn in Tianfu 8, floodwaters in the capital stood three feet deep.
units.literal: In the autumn, seventh month, first day dingchou of the eighth year of Tianfu, in the capital rain water stood three chi deep.

units.zh: 辛巳，許州節度使李從溫來朝，進封楚國公。
units.en: On xinsi Li Congwen, military commissioner of Xuzhou, arrived at court and was promoted to Duke of Chu.
units.literal: On xinsi, Li Congwen, military commissioner of Xuzhou, came to court and was advanced to Duke of Chu.

units.zh: 壬午，以前河陽節度使皇甫遇為右龍武統軍。
units.en: On renwu former Heyang commissioner Huangfu Yu was appointed commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard.
units.literal: On renwu, the former military commissioner of Heyang, Huangfu Yu, was made commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard.

units.zh: 丁亥，以宣徽南院使李承福為同州節度使。
units.en: On dinghai Li Chengfu of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat was made military commissioner of Tongzhou.
units.literal: On dinghai, Li Chengfu, commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made military commissioner of Tongzhou.

units.zh: 癸巳，改陜州甘棠驛為通津驛，避廟諱也。
units.en: On guisi the Sweet Pear post station in Shaan Prefecture was renamed Crossing Ford post station to avoid the imperial temple taboo.
units.literal: On guisi, the Sweet Pear post station in Shaanzhou was renamed Crossing Ford post station, to avoid the temple taboo.

units.zh: 甲午，正衙命冊皇太后，以宰臣李崧充使，右散騎常侍李慎儀為副。
units.en: On jiawu the court ordered the investiture of the empress dowager, with Chief Minister Li Song as chief envoy and Right Cavalry Attendant Li Shenyi as deputy.
units.literal: On jiawu, at the main court an order was issued to invest the empress dowager; the chief minister Li Song served as chief envoy and the Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Li Shenyi as deputy.

units.zh: 丁酉，幸南莊，召從駕臣僚習射，路左農人各賜布衫麻屨。
units.en: On dingyou the emperor visited South Manor and called the officials in his train to practice archery; farmers along the road were each given cloth jackets and hemp sandals.
units.literal: On dingyou, the emperor visited South Manor, summoned the officials in his train to practice archery, and each farmer along the road was given a cloth jacket and hemp sandals.

units.zh: 八月戊申，右衛上將軍楊思權卒，贈太傅。
units.en: In the eighth month, on wushen, Yang Siquan, senior general of the Right Guard, died and was posthumously made Grand Tutor.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on wushen, Yang Siquan, senior general of the Right Guard, died and was posthumously given Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 辛亥，分命朝臣一十三人分檢諸州旱苗。
units.en: On xinhai thirteen court officials were dispatched to inspect drought damage to crops in the prefectures.
units.literal: On xinhai, thirteen court officials were separately appointed to inspect drought-stricken crops in the various prefectures.

units.zh: 涇、青、磁、鄴都共奏逃戶凡五千八百九十。
units.en: Jing, Qing, Ci, and Yedu jointly reported a total of 5,890 fleeing households.
units.literal: Jing, Qing, Ci, and Yedu together memorialized that fleeing households totaled five thousand eight hundred ninety.

units.zh: 諸縣令佐以天災民餓，攜牌印納者五。
units.en: Five county magistrates and assistants surrendered their seals, citing natural disaster and famine among the people.
units.literal: Among county magistrates and assistants, five surrendered their nameplates and seals because of natural disaster and starving people.

units.zh: 癸酉，以前昭義節度使李從敏為左龍武統軍。
units.en: On guiyou former Zhaoyi commissioner Li Congmin was appointed commander of the Left Dragon Martial Guard.
units.literal: On guiyou, the former military commissioner of Zhaoyi, Li Congmin, was made commander of the Left Dragon Martial Guard.

units.zh: 九月戊寅，尊秦國夫人安氏為皇太妃，帝所生母也。
units.en: In the ninth month, on wuyin, Lady An of Qin was honored as imperial grand consort—the emperor's biological mother.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on wuyin, Lady An of Qin was honored as imperial grand consort, the emperor's birth mother.

units.zh: 丁亥，追冊故魏國夫人張氏為皇后，帝之元妃也。
units.en: On dinghai the late Lady Zhang of Wei was posthumously invested as empress; she had been the emperor's first consort.
units.literal: On dinghai, the late Lady Zhang of Wei was posthumously invested as empress; she had been the emperor's primary consort.

units.zh: 丙子，以金部郎中、知制誥馮玉為檢校尚書右僕射，充潁州團練使。
units.en: On bingzi Feng Yu, a bureau director in the Ministry of Revenue and edict drafter, was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and regimental commissioner of Ying Prefecture.
units.literal: On bingzi, Feng Yu, bureau director in the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of edicts, was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and filled the post of regimental commissioner of Yingzhou.

units.zh: 戊子，前潁州團練使田令方追奪在身官爵，勒歸私第，坐前任耀州日，額外配民曲錢納歸私室故也。
units.en: On wuzi former Ying regimental commissioner Tian Lingfang was stripped of his offices and sent home, having during his Yaozhou tenure levied extra entertainment fees from the people for his private use.
units.literal: On wuzi, Tian Lingfang, former regimental commissioner of Yingzhou, had his active offices and ranks stripped and was ordered back to his private residence, because during his former tenure in Yaozhou he had levied extra entertainment-money from the people and taken it into his private quarters.

units.zh: 延州奏，綏州刺史李彜敏拋棄城郡，與弟彜俊等五人將骨肉二百七十口來投，當州押送赴闕，稱與兄夏州節度使彜殷偶起猜嫌，互相攻伐故也。
units.en: Yan Prefecture reported that Suizhou prefect Li Yimin had abandoned his post and, with brothers Yijun and four others, brought 270 kin to surrender; the prefecture escorted them to court, citing mutual suspicion and fighting with his brother Yiyin, commissioner of Xia.
units.literal: Yanzhou memorialized that Li Yimin, prefect of Suizhou, had abandoned his city and prefecture; with his brothers Yijun and four others he brought two hundred seventy kin to surrender; the prefecture escorted them to court, stating that he and his elder brother Yiyin, military commissioner of Xiazhou, had suddenly grown suspicious of each other and attacked one another.

units.zh: 辛卯，夏州奏，差宥州刺史李仁立權知綏州。
units.en: On xinmao Xia Prefecture reported that Youzhou prefect Li Renli had been assigned to act as prefect of Suizhou.
units.literal: On xinmao, Xiazhou memorialized that Li Renli, prefect of Youzhou, was dispatched to act as prefect of Suizhou.

units.zh: 癸巳，故絳州刺史張從訓贈太尉，追冊皇后之父也。
units.en: On guisi the late Jiangzhou prefect Zhang Congxun was posthumously made Grand Marshal and invested as father of the empress.
units.literal: On guisi, the late Zhang Congxun, prefect of Jiangzhou, was posthumously given Grand Marshal; he was posthumously invested as the empress's father.

units.zh: 甲午，夏州李彜殷奏：「衙內都指揮使拓拔崇斌等五人作亂，當時收擒處斬訖。
units.en: On jiawu Li Yiyin of Xia reported: "Director of inner headquarters guards Tuoba Chongbin and four others rebelled; they were seized and executed at once.
units.literal: On jiawu, Li Yiyin of Xiazhou memorialized: "The director of inner headquarters guards Tuoba Chongbin and four others rebelled; they were seized and executed on the spot.

units.zh: 相次綏州刺史李彜敏擅將兵士，直抵城門，尋差人掩殺，彜敏知事不濟，與弟五人將家南走。」
units.en: Soon after, Suizhou prefect Li Yimin led troops without authorization to the city gate; an ambush was sent against him, and seeing the cause lost, he fled south with five brothers and their families."
units.literal: Shortly afterward Suizhou prefect Li Yimin on his own led troops straight to the city gate; men were soon sent to ambush and kill them; Yimin knew the affair would not succeed and fled south with five brothers and their households."

units.zh: 詔：「李彜敏潛結兇黨，顯恣逆謀。
units.en: An edict declared: "Li Yimin secretly allied with criminals and openly pursued rebellion.
units.literal: An edict said: "Li Yimin secretly joined with vicious partisans and openly indulged treasonous designs.

units.zh: 骨肉之間，尚興屠害；
units.en: Even among kin he still brought slaughter;
units.literal: Even among flesh and blood he still raised slaughter;

units.zh: 照臨之內，難以含容。
units.en: within the emperor's grace such conduct cannot be borne.
units.literal: within the realm of imperial grace he cannot be tolerated.

units.zh: 送夏州處斬。」
units.en: Send him to Xia for execution."
units.literal: Send him to Xiazhou for execution."

units.zh: 丙申，幸大年莊，遂幸侍衛使景延廣第。
units.en: On bingshen the emperor visited Great Year Manor, then the home of Palace Guards commissioner Jing Yanguang.
units.literal: On bingshen, the emperor visited Great Year Manor, then visited the residence of the commissioner of the Palace Guards, Jing Yanguang.

units.zh: 延廣進金玉器玩，賜延廣玉帶名馬，母妻、賓佐、部曲、僮仆錫賫鹹及之。
units.en: Yanguang presented gold, jade, vessels, and curios; the emperor gave him a jade belt and fine horses, with gifts extending equally to his mother, wife, staff, retainers, and servants.
units.literal: Yanguang presented gold, jade, vessels, and curios; the emperor bestowed on Yanguang a jade belt and famous horses, and rewards extended equally to his mother, wife, guests, staff, retainers, and servants.

units.zh: 庚子，以右諫議大夫邊光範為給事中，以吏部郎中劉知新為右諫議大夫。
units.en: On gengzi Right Remonstrance Grandee Bian Guangfan was made Supervising Secretary, and Personnel bureau director Liu Zhixin was made Right Remonstrance Grandee.
units.literal: On gengzi, Bian Guangfan, Right Remonstrance Grandee, was made Supervising Secretary; Liu Zhixin, bureau director in the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Remonstrance Grandee.

units.zh: 是月，諸州郡括借到軍食，以籍來上，吏民有隱落者，並處極法。
units.en: That month prefectures requisitioned army provisions and submitted registers; officials or commoners who concealed entries were all punished by death.
units.literal: That month, the various prefectures and commanderies requisitioned army provisions on loan and submitted registers; officials and commoners who concealed or omitted entries were all punished by the extreme penalty.

units.zh: 州郡二十七蝗，餓死者數十萬。
units.en: Locusts struck twenty-seven prefectures, and hundreds of thousands starved to death.
units.literal: Twenty-seven prefectures and commanderies had locusts; those who starved to death numbered in the hundreds of thousands.

units.zh: 冬十月戊申，制以吳國夫人馮氏為皇后，仍令所司擇日備禮冊命。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen, Lady Feng of Wu was made empress by edict, and the relevant offices were ordered to choose a day for the investiture rites.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wushen, an edict made Lady Feng of Wu empress and ordered the relevant offices to choose a day and prepare the rites of investiture.

units.zh: 庚戌，封皇第十一妹為嘉興長公主，第十二妹為永泰長公主。
units.en: On gengxu the emperor's eleventh younger sister was made Princess of Jiaxing and the twelfth Princess of Yongtai.
units.literal: On gengxu, the emperor's eleventh younger sister was enfeoffed as Princess of Jiaxing, and the twelfth as Princess of Yongtai.

units.zh: 是夕五更，有彗見於東方，在角，旬日而滅。
units.en: That night at the fifth watch a comet appeared in the east in the Horn constellation and faded after ten days.
units.literal: That night at the fifth watch a comet appeared in the east, in the Horn constellation, and vanished after ten days.

units.zh: 壬子，以權知延州軍州事、前鳳州防禦使杜威為延州留後。
units.en: On renzi Du Wei, acting administrator of Yan and former Feng defense commissioner, was made acting prefect of Yan.
units.literal: On renzi, Du Wei, acting administrator of Yanzhou's military and civil affairs and former defense commissioner of Fengzhou, was made acting prefect of Yanzhou.

units.zh: 甲寅，以國子祭酒兼戶部侍郎田敏充宏文館學士，判館事；
units.en: On jiayin Tian Min, Libationer of the Directorate of Education and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Hongwen Hall academician and placed in charge of the institute;
units.literal: On jiayin, Tian Min, Libationer of the Directorate of Education and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made academician of the Hongwen Hall and oversaw its affairs;

units.zh: 以吏部侍郎張昭遠充史館修撰，判館事；
units.en: Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made History Institute compiler and placed in charge of the institute;
units.literal: Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made compiler of the History Institute and oversaw its affairs;

units.zh: 以給事中司徒詡充集賢殿學士，判院事。
units.en: Supervising Secretary Situ Xu was made academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and placed in charge of the academy.
units.literal: Situ Xu, Supervising Secretary, was made academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and oversaw its affairs.

units.zh: 西京奏，百姓馬知饒殺男吳九不死，以其侵母食也。
units.en: The Western Capital reported that commoner Ma Zhirao attacked his son Wu Jiu without killing him, because the boy had taken his mother's food.
units.literal: The Western Capital memorialized that the commoner Ma Zhirao struck his son Wu Jiu to kill him, but the son did not die, because the son had encroached on his mother's food.

units.zh: 詔赦之。
units.en: An edict pardoned him.
units.literal: An edict pardoned him.

units.zh: 甲子，以前延州節度使何健為涇州節度使。
units.en: On jiazi former Yan commissioner He Jian was made military commissioner of Jing.
units.literal: On jiazi, the former military commissioner of Yanzhou, He Jian, was made military commissioner of Jingzhou.

units.zh: 丙寅，以涇州節度使王周為陜府節度使。
units.en: On bingyin Jing commissioner Wang Zhou was made military commissioner of Shaan.
units.literal: On bingyin, Wang Zhou, military commissioner of Jingzhou, was made military commissioner of the Shaan prefecture.

units.zh: 己巳，以左散騎常侍、權知開封府事邊蔚為工部侍郎，依前知府事。
units.en: On jisi Bian Wei, Left Cavalry Attendant and acting Kaifeng administrator, was made Vice Minister of Works while continuing to administer the prefecture.
units.literal: On jisi, Bian Wei, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry and acting administrator of Kaifeng prefecture, was made Vice Minister of Works and continued as before to administer the prefecture.

units.zh: 壬申，以前兵部侍郎李玘為吏部侍郎。
units.en: On renshen former Vice Minister of War Li Qi was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: On renshen, the former Vice Minister of War, Li Qi, was made Vice Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 癸酉，命使攝太尉、右僕射平章事和凝，使副攝司徒、給事中邊光範追冊故魏國夫人張氏為皇后，奉寶冊至西莊影殿行禮，鹵簿儀仗如式。
units.en: On guiyou He Ning, acting Grand Marshal and Right Vice Director, was chief envoy and Bian Guangfan, acting Minister over the Masses (Situ) and Supervising Secretary, deputy, to posthumously invest the late Lady Zhang of Wei as empress; they carried the seal and register to the Shadow Hall at West Manor with full ceremonial escort.
units.literal: On guiyou, He Ning, acting Grand Marshal, Right Vice Director and Grand Councilor, was appointed chief envoy, and Bian Guangfan, acting Minister of Works and Supervising Secretary, deputy, to posthumously invest the late Lady Zhang of Wei as empress; they bore the imperial seal and register to the Shadow Hall at West Manor to perform the rites, with guard of honor and ceremonial regalia according to regulation.

units.zh: 十一月丁丑，以鄧州節度使宋彥筠為晉州節度使，以涇州節度使何建為鄧州節度使。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, Dengzhou commissioner Song Yanyun was transferred to Jinzhou, and Jingzhou commissioner He Jian to Dengzhou.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, Song Yanyun, military commissioner of Dengzhou, was made military commissioner of Jinzhou; He Jian, military commissioner of Jingzhou, was made military commissioner of Dengzhou.

units.zh: 己卯，以前鄴都留守、廣晉尹李德充為涇州節度使。
units.en: On jimao former Yedu garrison commander and Guangjin metropolitan governor Li Dechong was made military commissioner of Jing.
units.literal: On jimao, Li Dechong, former garrison commander of Yedu and metropolitan governor of Guangjin, was made military commissioner of Jingzhou.

units.zh: 丙申，所司奏議，故天下兵馬都元帥、吳越國王錢元瓘謚曰莊穆，詔改為文穆。
units.en: On bingshen the relevant offices proposed the posthumous title Solemn and Reverent for the late commander-in-chief and King Qian Yuanguan of Wuyue; an edict changed it to Cultured and Reverent.
units.literal: On bingshen, the relevant offices submitted for deliberation that the late Commander-in-Chief of All Armies and Horses, King Qian Yuanguan of Wuyue, should receive the posthumous title Zhuangmu (Solemn and Reverent); an edict changed it to Wenmu (Cultured and Reverent).

units.zh: 戊戌，遣前復州防禦使吳巒權知貝州軍事，詔節度使王令溫赴闕。
units.en: On wuxu former Fu defense commissioner Wu Luan was sent to act as Bei's military administrator, and commissioner Wang Lingwen was ordered to court.
units.literal: On wuxu, the former defense commissioner of Fuzhou, Wu Luan, was dispatched to act as administrator of Beizhou's military affairs; an edict ordered military commissioner Wang Lingwen to come to court.

units.zh: 庚戌，單州軍事判官趙嶽奏，刺史楊承祚初夜開門出城，稱為母病，往青州寧親，於孔目官齊琪處留下牌印，臣已行用權知州事。
units.en: On gengxu Dan military adjutant Zhao Yue reported that Prefect Yang Chengzuo had left the city at night, claiming his mother was ill and he was going to Qing to visit kin; he left his seal with clerk Qi Qi, and Zhao was acting prefect.
units.literal: On gengxu, Zhao Yue, military adjutant of Danzhou, memorialized that Prefect Yang Chengzuo at the start of night opened the gate and left the city, saying his mother was ill and he was going to Qingzhou to comfort his kin; he left his nameplate and seal with the clerk Qi Qi; your servant has already exercised them and is acting as prefect.

units.zh: 辛丑，高麗遣使朝貢。
units.en: On xinchou Goryeo sent tribute envoys to court.
units.literal: On xinchou, Goryeo sent envoys with tribute to court.

units.zh: 昭化軍節度使、瑞慎等州觀察等使杜建徽進封鄖國公。
units.en: Du Jianhui, commissioner of Zhaohua and overseer of Rui, Shen, and other prefectures, was promoted to Duke of Yun.
units.literal: Du Jianhui, military commissioner of the Zhaohua Army and overseer of Ruizhou, Shenzhou, and other prefectures, was advanced to Duke of Yun.

units.zh: 遣侍衛步軍都指揮使郭謹領兵赴鄆州。
units.en: Palace Guards infantry commander Guo Jin was sent with troops to Yun.
units.literal: The Palace Guards infantry commander Guo Jin was dispatched to lead troops to Yunzhou.

units.zh: 十二月乙巳朔，遣左領軍衛將軍蔡行遇押兵士屯於鄆州，仍遣供奉官殿直二十六人，自河陰至海口，分擘地分巡檢，以青州節度使楊光遠謀叛故也。
units.en: On the first day yisi of the twelfth month, Left Leading Army Guard general Cai Xingyu was sent to garrison troops at Yun, and twenty-six inner-hall attendants were dispatched from Heyin to Haikou to patrol by district, because Qing commissioner Yang Guangyuan was plotting rebellion.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, first day yisi, Left Leading Army Guard general Cai Xingyu was sent to escort troops to garrison at Yunzhou; twenty-six palace attendants of the inner hall were also dispatched from Heyin to Haikou to divide the territory and conduct inspections, because Qingzhou military commissioner Yang Guangyuan was plotting rebellion.

units.zh: 庚戌，前左禦正齊國夫人吳氏巳降二十一人，並封郡國夫人，太后宮、皇后宮知客夫人等亦如之。
units.en: On gengxu former Left Director of Correct Deportment Lady Wu of Qi and twenty-one women of lower rank were all made ladies of commandery or state, as were guest-receiving ladies of the empress dowager's and empress's palaces.
units.literal: On gengxu, the former Left Director of Correct Deportment, Lady Wu of Qi, and twenty-one women of lower rank were all enfeoffed as ladies of commandery or state; ladies who received guests in the empress dowager's palace and empress's palace were treated likewise.

units.zh: 太子太保致仕梁文矩卒，贈太子太傅。
units.en: Retired Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent Liang Wenju died and was posthumously made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: Liang Wenju, retired Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, died and was posthumously given Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 癸丑，詔河陽節度使符彥卿、宋州節度使高行周、貝州節度使王令溫、同州節度使李承福、陳州梁漢璋、亳州李萼、懷州薛懷讓並赴闕，分命使臣諸州郡巡檢，以契丹入寇故也。
units.en: On guichou an edict summoned commissioners Fu Yanqing of Heyang, Gao Xingzhou of Song, Wang Lingwen of Bei, Li Chenfu of Tong, Liang Hanzhang of Chen, Li E of Bo, and Xue Huairang of Huai to court and dispatched envoys to inspect the prefectures, because the Khitan had invaded.
units.literal: On guichou, an edict ordered military commissioners Fu Yanqing of Heyang, Gao Xingzhou of Songzhou, Wang Lingwen of Beizhou, Li Chenfu of Tongzhou, Liang Hanzhang of Chenzhou, Li E of Bozhou, and Xue Huairang of Huaizhou all to come to court; envoys were separately appointed to inspect the various prefectures and commanderies, because the Khitan had entered to raid.

units.zh: 遣給事中邊光範、前登州刺史郭彥威使於契丹，行至恒州，敵已犯境，不能進，留於公館數月，不達其命而回。
units.en: Supervising Secretary Bian Guangfan and former Deng prefect Guo Yanwei were sent to the Khitan; at Heng the enemy had already crossed the border, so they could not proceed and stayed in the official hostel for months before returning without delivering their message.
units.literal: Supervising Secretary Bian Guangfan and former Dengzhou prefect Guo Yanwei were sent as envoys to the Khitan; reaching Hengzhou, the enemy had already violated the border and they could not advance; they remained in the public hostel several months and returned without delivering their commission.

units.zh: 〈（《遼史》：天福八年二月乙卯，晉遣使進先帝遺物。
units.en: (《History of Liao》: In the second month of Tianfu 8, on yimao, Jin sent envoys presenting the late emperor's relics.
units.literal: (《History of Liao》: In the second month of the eighth year of Tianfu, on yimao, Jin sent envoys presenting the late emperor's relics.

units.zh: 辛酉，晉遣使請居汴，從之。
units.en: On xinyou Jin envoys asked to reside at Bian; the request was granted.
units.literal: On xinyou, Jin sent envoys requesting to reside at Bian; it was granted.

units.zh: 三月丁未，晉主至汴，遣使來謝。
units.en: In the third month, on dingwei, the Jin ruler reached Bian and sent envoys to give thanks.
units.literal: In the third month, on dingwei, the Jin ruler arrived at Bian and sent envoys to give thanks.

units.zh: 五月己亥，遣使如晉，致生辰禮。
units.en: In the fifth month, on jihai, envoys were sent to Jin with birthday gifts.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on jihai, envoys were sent to Jin to present birthday rites.

units.zh: 六月辛酉，晉遣使貢金。
units.en: In the sixth month, on xinyou, Jin sent envoys with gold tribute.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on xinyou, Jin sent envoys presenting gold tribute.

units.zh: 秋八月丁未朔，晉復貢金。
units.en: On the first day dingwei of the eighth month of autumn, Jin again sent gold tribute.
units.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, first day dingwei, Jin again presented gold tribute.

units.zh: 己未，如奉聖州，晉遣其子延煦來朝。）〉
units.en: On jiwei he went to Fengsheng; Jin sent his son Yanshu to court.))〉
units.literal: On jiwei, he went to Fengshengzhou; Jin sent his son Yanshu to court.))〉

units.zh: 甲寅，以單州刺史楊承祚為登州刺史，從其便也。
units.en: On jiayin Dan prefect Yang Chengzuo was transferred to Dengzhou at his own request.
units.literal: On jiayin, Yang Chengzuo, prefect of Danzhou, was made prefect of Dengzhou, following his own convenience.

units.zh: 華州陜府奏，逃戶凡一萬二千三百。
units.en: Hua and the Shaan prefecture reported 12,300 fleeing households.
units.literal: Huazhou and the Shaan prefecture memorialized that fleeing households totaled twelve thousand three hundred.

units.zh: 乙丑，臘，車駕不出。
units.en: On yichou, at the La sacrifice, the emperor did not go abroad.
units.literal: On yichou, at the La sacrifice, the imperial carriage did not go out.

units.zh: 詔前陜州節度使石赟率諸節度使畋於郡郊。
units.en: An edict ordered former Shaan commissioner Shi Yun to lead the commissioners in a hunt in the suburban fields.
units.literal: An edict ordered the former military commissioner of Shaanzhou, Shi Yun, to lead the various military commissioners in hunting in the outskirts of the commandery.

units.zh: 太子賓客聶延祚卒。
units.en: Mentor of the Heir Apparent Nie Yanzuo died.
units.literal: Nie Yanzuo, Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died.

units.zh: 丁卯，詔宣徽使劉繼勛就杜威園亭會節度使統軍等習射。
units.en: On dingmao an edict had Palace Secretariat commissioner Liu Jixun gather commissioners and army commanders for archery at Du Wei's garden.
units.literal: On dingmao, an edict ordered Palace Secretariat commissioner Liu Jixun to hold a gathering of military commissioners, army commanders, and others for archery practice at Du Wei's garden pavilion.

units.zh: 淄州奏，青州節度使楊光遠反，遣兵士取淄州，劫刺史翟進宗入青州。
units.en: Zi Prefecture reported that Qing commissioner Yang Guangyuan had rebelled, seized Zi with troops, and abducted Prefect Zhai Jinzong into Qing.
units.literal: Zizhou memorialized that Qingzhou military commissioner Yang Guangyuan had rebelled, sent troops to take Zizhou, and seized Prefect Zhai Jinzong and carried him into Qingzhou.

units.zh: 是冬大饑，河南諸州餓死者二萬六千餘口。
units.en: That winter famine struck, and more than 26,000 starved to death in the Henan prefectures.
units.literal: That winter there was great famine; in the various prefectures of Henan those who starved to death numbered more than twenty-six thousand persons.

units.zh: 開運元年春正月甲戌朔，是夕陣雲掩北斗之魁星。
units.en: On the first day jiaxu of the first month of spring in Kaiyun 1, battle clouds that night veiled the leader star of the Northern Dipper.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, first day jiaxu of the first year of Kaiyun, that night battle clouds covered the leader star of the Northern Dipper.

units.zh: 乙亥，滄、恒、貝、鄴馳告，契丹前鋒趙延壽、趙延昭引五萬騎入寇，將及甘陵，青州楊光遠召之也。
units.en: On yihai Cang, Heng, Bei, and Ye sent urgent word that Khitan vanguard Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao were leading 50,000 horsemen in invasion toward Ganling—summoned by Yang Guangyuan of Qingzhou.
units.literal: On yihai, Cang, Heng, Bei, and Ye sent urgent reports that the Khitan vanguard Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao led fifty thousand horsemen in invasion, about to reach Ganling; Qingzhou's Yang Guangyuan had summoned them.

units.zh: 己卯，契丹陷貝州，知州吳巒死之。
units.en: On jimao the Khitan captured Bei; acting prefect Wu Luan was killed.
units.literal: On jimao, the Khitan took Beizhou; Acting Prefect Wu Luan died in the fighting.

units.zh: 庚辰，以宋州節度使高行周為北面行營都部署，以河陽節度使符彥卿為馬軍左廂排陣使，以右神武統軍皇甫遇為馬軍右廂排陣使，以陜州節度使王周為步軍左廂排陣使，以左羽林統軍潘環為步軍右廂排陣使。
units.en: On gengchen Song commissioner Gao Xingzhou was made overall commander of the northern campaign; Heyang commissioner Fu Yanqing was left-wing horse array marshal; Right Divine Martial commander Huangfu Yu was right-wing horse marshal; Shaan commissioner Wang Zhou was left-wing foot marshal; and Left Feathered Forest commander Pan Huan was right-wing foot marshal.
units.literal: On gengchen, Gao Xingzhou, military commissioner of Songzhou, was made overall commander of the Northern Campaign Headquarters; Fu Yanqing, military commissioner of Heyang, was made array marshal of the left wing of the horse army; Huangfu Yu, commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard, was made array marshal of the right wing of the horse army; Wang Zhou, military commissioner of Shaanzhou, was made array marshal of the left wing of the foot army; Pan Huan, commander of the Left Feathered Forest Guard, was made array marshal of the right wing of the foot army.

units.zh: 太原奏，契丹入雁門，圍忻、代二州。
units.en: Taiyuan reported that the Khitan had entered Yanmen Pass and besieged Xin and Dai.
units.literal: Taiyuan memorialized that the Khitan had entered Yanmen and besieged Xinzhou and Daizhou.

units.zh: 恒、滄、邢三州上言，契丹大至。
units.en: Heng, Cang, and Xing reported that the Khitan had arrived in force.
units.literal: Heng, Cang, and Xing submitted memorials that the Khitan had arrived in force.

units.zh: 是歲，天下餓死者數十萬人，詔逐處長吏瘞之。
units.en: That year hundreds of thousands starved to death empire-wide, and an edict ordered local officials to bury them.
units.literal: That year, those who starved to death under Heaven numbered in the hundreds of thousands; an edict ordered local chief officials everywhere to bury them.

units.zh: 壬午，詔取此月十三日車駕北征，以前邠州節度使李周為權東京留守。
units.en: On renwu an edict set the thirteenth of the month for the emperor's northern expedition and made former Bin commissioner Li Zhou acting garrison commander of the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: On renwu, an edict set the thirteenth day of this month for the imperial carriage's northern expedition; the former military commissioner of Binzhou, Li Zhou, was made acting garrison commander of the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 乙酉，車駕發東京。
units.en: On yiyou the emperor departed the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: On yiyou, the imperial carriage departed the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 丁亥，敵騎至黎陽。
units.en: On dinghai enemy cavalry reached Liyang.
units.literal: On dinghai, enemy horsemen reached Liyang.

units.zh: 以侍衛馬軍都指揮使李守貞為前軍都虞候。
units.en: Palace Guards cavalry commander Li Shouzhen was made vanguard chief adjutant.
units.literal: Li Shouzhen, commander of the Palace Guards horse army, was made chief adjutant of the vanguard.

units.zh: 河北危蹙，諸州求救者人使相望。
units.en: Hebei was in dire straits, and envoys begging rescue came one after another from the prefectures.
units.literal: Hebei was in peril and pressed; among the prefectures those sending envoys to beg rescue were unceasing.

units.zh: 戊子，車駕至澶州。
units.en: On wuzi the emperor reached Chanzhou.
units.literal: On wuzi, the imperial carriage reached Chanzhou.

units.zh: 以貝州節度使王令溫為鄧州節度使，時令溫弟令崇自契丹至，訴以舉族陷於甘陵，故有是命。
units.en: Bei commissioner Wang Lingwen was transferred to Deng because his brother Lingchong had come from the Khitan and reported that their whole clan was trapped at Ganling.
units.literal: Wang Lingwen, military commissioner of Beizhou, was made military commissioner of Dengzhou; at the time Lingwen's younger brother Lingchong had come from the Khitan and complained that the whole clan was trapped at Ganling, hence this appointment.

units.zh: 辛卯，鄴都留守張從恩遣人夜縋城間行，奏契丹主以鐵騎三四萬建牙帳於元城，以趙延壽為魏博節度使，改封魏王，延壽日率騎軍摩壘而退。
units.en: On xinmao Yedu garrison commander Zhang Congen sent men down the wall by night with a secret report: the Khitan ruler had pitched camp at Yuancheng with 30,000–40,000 armored horsemen, made Zhao Yanshou Weibo commissioner and Prince of Wei, and Yanshou daily led cavalry to skirmish at the walls before withdrawing.
units.literal: On xinmao, Zhang Congen, garrison commander of Yedu, sent men at night to lower themselves by rope from the wall and travel by secret paths, memorializing that the Khitan ruler had set up his command tent at Yuancheng with thirty or forty thousand iron cavalry, made Zhao Yanshou military commissioner of Weibo and changed his enfeoffment to Prince of Wei; Yanshou daily led cavalry to press the ramparts and then withdraw.

units.zh: 甲午，以北京留守劉知遠為幽州道行營招討使，以恒州節度使杜威副之，定州節度使馬全節為都虞候，其職員將校委招討使便宜署置。
units.en: On jiawu Northern Capital garrison commander Liu Zhiyuan was made pacification commissioner for the Youzhou campaign, with Heng commissioner Du Wei as deputy and Ding commissioner Ma Quanjie as chief adjutant; staff and generals were left to the commissioner's discretion.
units.literal: On jiawu, Liu Zhiyuan, garrison commander of the Northern Capital, was made pacification commissioner of the Youzhou circuit campaign headquarters; Du Wei, military commissioner of Hengzhou, was his deputy; Ma Quanjie, military commissioner of Dingzhou, was chief adjutant; staff officers and generals were entrusted to the pacification commissioner to appoint at discretion.

units.zh: 乙未，大霧中有白虹相偶，占者曰：「斯為海淫，其下必將有戰。」
units.en: On yiwei a white rainbow appeared paired in heavy fog; diviners said, "This is a sign of maritime excess—battle will surely follow below."
units.literal: On yiwei, in great fog a white rainbow paired with another; diviners said: "This is sea excess; below there will surely be battle."

units.zh: 詔率天下公私之馬以資騎軍。
units.en: An edict ordered all public and private horses empire-wide levied for the cavalry.
units.literal: An edict ordered the levying of all public and private horses under Heaven to supply the cavalry.

units.zh: 丙申，契丹攻黎陽。
units.en: On bingshen the Khitan attacked Liyang.
units.literal: On bingshen, the Khitan attacked Liyang.

units.zh: 遣右武衛上將軍張彥澤等率勁騎三千以禦之。
units.en: Right Martial Guard senior general Zhang Yanzhe and others were sent with 3,000 elite cavalry to resist them.
units.literal: Zhang Yanzhe, senior general of the Right Martial Guard, and others were sent to lead three thousand crack cavalry to resist them.

units.zh: 己亥，遣譯詔官孟守忠致書於契丹主，求修舊好。
units.en: On jihai translation officer Meng Shouzhong was sent with a letter to the Khitan ruler seeking to restore the old alliance.
units.literal: On jihai, the translation edict officer Meng Shouzhong was sent with a letter to the Khitan ruler seeking to restore the former good relations.

units.zh: 守忠自敵帳回，契丹主復書曰：「已成之勢，不可改也。」
units.en: When Shouzhong returned from the enemy camp, the Khitan ruler replied, "What is already settled cannot be changed."
units.literal: Shouzhong returned from the enemy camp; the Khitan ruler replied in a letter: "The situation already formed cannot be changed."

units.zh: 辛丑，太原奏，與契丹戰於秀谷，斬首三千級，生擒五百人，獲敵將一十七人，賊軍散入鴉鳴谷，已進軍追襲。
units.en: On xinchou Taiyuan reported fighting the Khitan at Xiugu, beheading 3,000, capturing 500 alive and 17 enemy generals; the enemy scattered into Crow Cry Valley and pursuit was under way.
units.literal: On xinchou, Taiyuan memorialized that it had fought the Khitan at Xiugu, beheaded three thousand, captured five hundred alive, took seventeen enemy generals; the rebel army scattered into Crow Cry Valley and the army had already advanced in pursuit.

units.zh: 二月甲辰朔，遣石赟守麻家口，何建守楊劉鎮，白再榮守馬家渡，安彥威守河陽。
units.en: On the first day jiachen of the second month, Shi Yun was sent to hold Majiakou, He Jian to hold Yangliu town, Bai Zairong to hold Majia ford, and An Yanwei to hold Heyang.
units.literal: In the second month, first day jiachen, Shi Yun was sent to hold Majiakou, He Jian to hold Yangliu town, Bai Zairong to hold Majia ford, and An Yanwei to hold Heyang.

units.zh: 鄆州奏，博州刺史周儒以城降契丹，又與楊光遠潛約，光遠引契丹於馬家渡濟河。
units.en: Yunzhou reported that Bozhou prefect Zhou Ru had surrendered his city to the Khitan and secretly agreed with Yang Guangyuan to bring the Khitan across the river at Majia ford.
units.literal: Yunzhou memorialized that Zhou Ru, prefect of Bozhou, had surrendered the city to the Khitan, and had also made a secret pact with Yang Guangyuan; Guangyuan led the Khitan to cross the river at Majia ford.

units.zh: 時郭謹在汶陽，遣左武衛將軍蔡行遇率數百騎赴之。
units.en: Guo Jin was then at Wenyang and sent Left Martial Guard general Cai Xingyu with several hundred horsemen to their aid.
units.literal: At the time Guo Jin was at Wenyang and sent Left Martial Guard general Cai Xingyu with several hundred cavalry to go to their aid.

units.zh: 遇伏兵於葭葦中，突然而出，轉鬥數合，部下皆遁，行遇為賊所執，鋒鏑重傷，不能乘馬，坐畚中舁至幕帳。
units.en: Ambushers burst from the reeds; after several clashes his men fled, and Xingyu was taken with grave wounds, unable to ride, and was carried in a basket to the enemy command tent.
units.literal: He met with ambush troops in the reeds and rushes; they burst out suddenly; after several rounds of fighting his subordinates all fled; Xingyu was seized by the bandits, gravely wounded by blades and arrows, unable to ride a horse, and was carried seated in a basket to the command tent.

units.zh: 遣李守貞等水陸進兵而下，以救汶陽。
units.en: Li Shouzhen and others were sent by land and water downstream to relieve Wenyang.
units.literal: Li Shouzhen and others were dispatched with land and water forces to advance downstream and rescue Wenyang.

units.zh: 丙午，先鋒指揮使石公霸與契丹遇於戚城之北，為契丹所圍。
units.en: On bingwu vanguard commander Shi Gongba met the Khitan north of Qicheng and was encircled.
units.literal: On bingwu, vanguard commander Shi Gongba encountered the Khitan north of Qicheng and was surrounded by the Khitan.

units.zh: 高行周、符彥卿方息於林下，聞賊至駭愕，督軍而進。
units.en: Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing were resting under the trees when news of the enemy arrived; startled, they rallied the army and advanced.
units.literal: Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing were just resting beneath the trees; hearing the bandits had arrived they were shocked and alarmed, and urged the army forward.

units.zh: 契丹眾甚盛，被圍數重，遣人馳告景延廣，請益師。
units.en: The Khitan were overwhelming; trapped in rings of encirclement, they sent a rider to Jing Yanguang begging for reinforcements.
units.literal: The Khitan force was very strong; encircled layer upon layer, they sent a man galloping to inform Jing Yanguang and request additional troops.

units.zh: 延廣遲留，候帝進止。
units.en: Yanguang held back, waiting for orders from the emperor.
units.literal: Yanguang delayed, awaiting the emperor's decision.

units.zh: 行周等大噪，瞋目奮擊賊眾，傷死者甚多，帝自禦親兵救之方解。
units.en: Xingzhou and the others roared and charged with blazing eyes; casualties mounted until the emperor led the palace guard in person and broke the encirclement.
units.literal: Xingzhou and the others raised a great clamor, glared and fought fiercely against the bandit horde; the wounded and dead were very many; the emperor personally led the imperial guard to rescue them before the siege was lifted.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·符彥卿傳》：契丹騎兵數萬，圍高行周於鐵丘，諸將莫敢當其鋒，彥卿獨引數百騎擊之，遼人遁去，行周得免。
units.en: (History of Song, Biography of Fu Yanqing: Khitan cavalry numbering in the tens of thousands had Gao Xingzhou trapped at Iron Mound; no general would face them until Yanqing alone led a few hundred riders in a charge that drove the Liao off and freed Xingzhou.
units.literal: (History of Song, Biography of Fu Yanqing: Tens of thousands of Khitan horsemen surrounded Gao Xingzhou at Iron Mound; none of the generals dared meet their charge, but Yanqing alone led several hundred horsemen to attack them; the Liao men fled and Xingzhou escaped.

units.zh: 《高懷德傳》：至戚城，被圍數重，援兵不至，危甚，懷德左右射，縱橫馳突，眾皆披靡，挾父而出。）〉
units.en: History of Song, Biography of Gao Huai'de: At Qicheng they were ringed again and again with no relief in sight; Huai'de fought shooting in every direction, broke through the press, and carried his father out.))〉
units.literal: History of Song, Biography of Gao Huai'de: Reaching Qicheng, they were encircled layer upon layer; reinforcements did not arrive and the peril was extreme; Huai'de shot to left and right, charged to and fro, the troops all gave way, and he bore his father out.))〉

units.zh: 登戚城古臺，置酒以勞三將，鹹咎延廣不遣兵赴難，相對泣下。
units.en: On Qicheng's old terrace they held a feast for the three generals, all reproached Yanguang for failing to send aid, and wept together.
units.literal: They ascended the ancient platform at Qicheng, set out wine to reward the three generals, all blamed Yanguang for not sending troops to their relief, and wept facing one another.

units.zh: 戊申，契丹築壘於馬家渡東岸，以騎軍列於外，以禦王師。
units.en: On wushen the Khitan threw up earthworks on the east bank of Majia ford and posted cavalry outside to block the imperial army.
units.literal: On wushen, the Khitan built fortifications on the east bank of Majia ford, deployed cavalry outside to resist the imperial army.

units.zh: 李守貞以師搏之，遂破其眾。
units.en: Li Shouzhen engaged them and routed their force.
units.literal: Li Shouzhen attacked them with his force and broke their army.

units.zh: 敵騎散走，赴河溺死者數千，遂拔其壘。
units.en: Enemy riders broke and ran; thousands drowned in the river, and the Khitan camp was taken.
units.literal: Enemy horsemen scattered and fled; several thousand drowned rushing into the river; their fortifications were then taken.

units.zh: 初，西岸敵軍數萬，鼓噪揚旗以助其勢，及見東岸兵敗，號哭而去。
units.en: Earlier, tens of thousands on the west bank had drummed and waved banners to encourage their comrades; seeing the east-bank force collapse, they wailed and withdrew.
units.literal: Earlier, tens of thousands of enemy troops on the west bank had drummed, shouted, and raised banners to boost their momentum; when they saw the east-bank army defeated, they wailed and departed.

units.zh: 獲馬八百匹，生擒賊將七十八人，部眾五百人，送行在，悉斬之。
units.en: Eight hundred horses were seized; seventy-eight enemy officers and five hundred soldiers were captured alive, brought to the imperial camp, and executed.
units.literal: Eight hundred horses were captured; seventy-eight bandit generals and five hundred troopers were taken alive and sent to the imperial camp; all were beheaded.

units.zh: 辛亥，夏州節度使李彜殷合蕃漢之兵四萬抵麟州，濟河，侵契丹之境，以牽脅之。
units.en: On xinhai Xia Prefecture commissioner Li Yiyin united forty thousand Tangut and Han troops, reached Linzhou, crossed the river, and struck into Khitan lands to tie down the enemy.
units.literal: On xinhai, Li Yiyin, military commissioner of Xizhou, combined Tangut and Han forces numbering forty thousand, reached Linzhou, crossed the river, and invaded Khitan territory to pin them down.

units.zh: 壬子，以彜殷為契丹西南面招討使。
units.en: On renzi Yiyin was appointed Southwest Pacification Commissioner against the Khitan.
units.literal: On renzi, Yiyin was made Khitan Southwest Pacification Commissioner.

units.zh: 易州刺史安審約奏，戰契丹於北平，賊退保祁溝關，斷其橋梁而還。
units.en: Yi prefect An Shen'yue reported fighting the Khitan at Beiping; the enemy fell back to Qigou Pass, and he cut their bridges before returning.
units.literal: An Shen'yue, prefect of Yizhou, memorialized that he fought the Khitan at Beiping; the bandits retreated to hold Qigou Pass; he destroyed their bridges and returned.

units.zh: 癸丑，博州殘兵至自敵中。
units.en: On guichou survivors from Bozhou straggled in from behind enemy lines.
units.literal: On guichou, remnant troops from Bozhou arrived from within the enemy lines.

units.zh: 周儒之降也，賊執其軍士，將獻於幕帳，行次中途，守者夜寢，其中軍士一人自解桎梏，為諸兵釋縛，取敵戈矛，盡殺援者二百餘人，南走而歸，至河無舟，浮水而過，溺死之餘，所存者六十七人。
units.en: After Zhou Ru's surrender the enemy marched his men toward the Khitan camp; one night a soldier broke his bonds, freed his comrades, seized enemy weapons, and killed more than two hundred guards before fleeing south; with no boats at the river they swam across, and only sixty-seven survived the drowning.
units.literal: When Zhou Ru surrendered, the bandits held his soldiers to present at the command tent; en route the guards slept at night; one soldier freed himself from shackles, released the others, seized enemy spears and halberds, killed over two hundred escorts, fled south; at the river with no boats they floated across; after the drownings, sixty-seven remained.

units.zh: 是日，日有黃白暈，二白虹夾日而行。
units.en: That day the sun was ringed in yellow-white light, and two white rainbows ran alongside it.
units.literal: That day the sun had yellow-white halos; two white rainbows flanked the sun as they moved.

units.zh: 己未，滄州奏，賊眾三千人援送所掠人口寶貨等，由長蘆入蕃，以輕騎邀之，斬獲千餘人，人口輜重悉委之而走。
units.en: On jiwei Cangzhou reported three thousand raiders escorting captives and loot toward Khitan lands by way of Changlu; light cavalry ambushed them, killing or capturing over a thousand, and the enemy fled leaving people and baggage behind.
units.literal: On jiwei, Cangzhou memorialized: three thousand bandits were escorting plundered people and goods into Khitan territory via Changlu; light cavalry intercepted them, killed and captured over a thousand; people and baggage were all abandoned as they fled.

units.zh: 庚申，宰臣馮道等再上表請聽樂，皆不允。
units.en: On gengshen Chief Minister Feng Dao and others again petitioned to restore court music; the emperor refused.
units.literal: On gengshen, chief ministers Feng Dao and others again submitted memorials requesting permission for music; all were denied.

units.zh: 時帝自期年之後，於宮中間舉細聲女樂，及親征以來，日於左右召淺蕃軍校，奏三弦胡琴，和以羌笛，擊節鳴鼓，更舞叠歌，以為娛樂。
units.en: Since leaving mourning the emperor had kept soft female musicians in the palace; since taking the field in person he daily called frontier tribal officers to play sanxian and huqin with Qiang flutes, drums, and alternating song and dance for his amusement.
units.literal: At the time, since the end of the mourning period the emperor had occasionally had female musicians perform softly in the palace; since the personal campaign began, he daily summoned frontier tribal army officers to his side to play sanxian and huqin, harmonize with Qiang flutes, beat time and drums, and take turns dancing and singing for amusement.

units.zh: 常謂侍臣曰：「此非音樂也。」
units.en: He often told his attendants, "This is not music."
units.literal: He often told his attendants: "This is not music."

units.zh: 故馮道等奏請舉樂，詔旨未允而止。
units.en: So when Feng Dao and others asked to restore proper court music, the emperor's reply was refusal.
units.literal: Therefore when Feng Dao and others memorialized requesting formal music, the edict did not grant it and the matter ceased.

units.zh: 壬戌，楊光遠率兵圍冀州，刺史李瓊以州兵擊之，棄營而遁。
units.en: On renxu Yang Guangyuan besieged Jizhou; Prefect Li Qiong sallied with local troops and drove him from camp.
units.literal: On renxu, Yang Guangyuan led troops to besiege Jizhou; Prefect Li Qiong struck with prefectural troops; they abandoned camp and fled.

units.zh: 冀州奏，敗賊軍於城下，見舁棺者，訊其降者，曰「戚城之戰，上將金頭王中流矢而死，此其櫬也。」
units.en: Jizhou reported defeating the enemy below the walls and seeing a coffin borne past; captives said, "At Qicheng the chief commander Golden-Head King took an arrow and died—this is his coffin."
units.literal: Jizhou memorialized that the bandit army was defeated below the walls; they saw men carrying a coffin; questioning surrenderers, they said: "In the battle at Qicheng the supreme commander Golden-Head King was struck by an arrow and died; this is his bier."

units.zh: 癸亥，以前鄧州節度使何建為東南面馬步軍都部署，率師屯汶陽。
units.en: On guihai former Deng commissioner He Jian was made southeast theater commander of horse and foot and marched to Wenyang.
units.literal: On guihai, former Dengzhou military commissioner He Jian was made overall commander of cavalry and infantry on the southeast front, leading troops to encamp at Wenyang.

units.zh: 甲子，蜀人寇我階州。
units.en: On jiazi Shu troops attacked Jie Prefecture.
units.literal: On jiazi, Shu forces raided our Jie Prefecture.

units.zh: 三月癸酉朔，契丹主領兵十餘萬來戰。
units.en: On the first day guiyou of the third month the Khitan ruler brought more than a hundred thousand men to fight.
units.literal: On the first day guiyou of the third month, the Khitan ruler led more than a hundred thousand troops to give battle.

units.zh: 時契丹偽棄元城寨已旬日矣，伏精騎於頓丘故城，以待王師。
units.en: The Khitan had pretended to quit Yuancheng camp for ten days, concealing crack cavalry in old Dunqiu to ambush the imperial army.
units.literal: At the time the Khitan had feigned abandoning Yuancheng stockade for ten days already, hiding elite cavalry in the old city of Dunqiu to await the imperial army.

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：鄴都留守張從恩屢奏敵已遁去，大軍欲進追之，會霖雨而止。）〉
units.en: (Zizhi Tongjian: Yedu garrison commander Zhang Congen kept reporting the enemy gone and urging pursuit, but the advance halted in torrential rain.)
units.literal: (Zizhi Tongjian: Zhang Congen, garrison commander of Yedu, repeatedly memorialized that the enemy had fled; the main army wished to advance in pursuit but stopped when heavy rain set in.)

units.zh: 設伏累日，人馬饑頓，趙延壽謀曰：「晉軍悉在河上，畏我鋒銳，不敢前進，不如徑造城下，四面而進，攻奪其橋梁，天下定矣。」
units.en: After days in ambush men and horses were starving; Zhao Yanshou urged, "Jin forces are pinned on the river, afraid of our edge—strike straight for the city, attack from four sides, seize the bridges, and the realm is ours."
units.literal: Having lain in ambush for days, men and horses were famished and exhausted; Zhao Yanshou plotted, saying: "The Jin army is all on the river; they fear our sharp edge and dare not advance; it would be better to go straight to the walls below the city, advance from all four sides, seize their bridges, and All under Heaven will be settled."

units.zh: 契丹主然之。
units.en: The Khitan ruler approved the plan.
units.literal: The Khitan ruler agreed.

units.zh: 是日，前軍高行周在戚城之南，賊將趙延壽、趙延昭以數萬騎出王師之西，契丹主自擁精騎出王師之東，兩軍接戰，交相勝負。
units.en: That day Gao Xingzhou's vanguard stood south of Qicheng while Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao led tens of thousands of riders against the imperial west flank and the Khitan ruler himself struck from the east; the battle seesawed.
units.literal: That day the advance force under Gao Xingzhou was south of Qicheng; the bandit generals Zhao Yanshou and Zhao Yanzhao led tens of thousands of horsemen out to the west of the imperial army; the Khitan ruler himself with elite cavalry came out to the east; the two armies joined battle with alternating victories and defeats.

units.zh: 至晡時，契丹主以勁兵中央出而來，帝御親軍列為後陣，東西濟河，為偃月之勢，旗幟鮮盛，士馬嚴整。
units.en: By late afternoon the Khitan ruler committed his center; the emperor took personal command of the palace guard in reserve while forces east and west crossed the river in a crescent formation, banners bright and ranks tight.
units.literal: By late afternoon the Khitan ruler brought strong troops out from the center; the emperor personally commanded the imperial guard arrayed as the rear formation; east and west they crossed the river in a crescent moon disposition; banners were brilliant and troops and horses were strict and orderly.

units.zh: 契丹主望之，謂左右曰：「楊光遠言晉朝兵馬半已餓死，今日觀之，何其壯耶！」
units.en: The Khitan ruler looked on and told his attendants, "Yang Guangyuan claimed half the Jin army had starved—yet see how strong they look today!"
units.literal: The Khitan ruler gazed at them and said to those beside him: "Yang Guangyuan said half the Jin court's troops and horses had already starved to death — viewing them today, how strong they are!"

units.zh: 敵騎往來馳突，王師植立不動，萬弩齊彀，飛矢蔽空，賊軍稍卻。
units.en: Enemy cavalry wheeled and charged while the imperial line held firm; a volley of ten thousand crossbows darkened the sky and the Khitan line began to give ground.
units.literal: Enemy horsemen galloped back and forth in raids; the imperial army stood planted unmoving; ten thousand crossbows released together; flying arrows covered the sky; the bandit army gradually fell back.

units.zh: 會有亡者告契丹主曰：「南軍東面人少，沿河城柵不固，可以攻之。」
units.en: A defector then told the Khitan ruler, "The southern line is weak on the east; the river forts are shaky—attack there."
units.literal: Then a deserter told the Khitan ruler: "The southern army's eastern flank is thinly manned; the riverside fortifications are not solid — they can be attacked."

units.zh: 契丹乃率精騎以攻東邊，王師敗走，敵騎追之。
units.en: The Khitan sent elite cavalry against the east; the imperial army broke and fled with enemy riders in pursuit.
units.literal: The Khitan then led elite cavalry to attack the eastern flank; the imperial army was defeated and fled; enemy horsemen pursued.

units.zh: 時有夾馬軍士千餘人在堤間治水寨，旗幟之末出於堰埭，敵望見之，以為伏兵所起，追騎乃止。
units.en: More than a thousand grooms were building waterworks on the dike; banner tips showed above the dam, and the pursuers mistook them for a fresh ambush and stopped.
units.literal: At the time more than a thousand horse-grooming soldiers were building water fortifications on the embankment; the tips of their banners showed above the weir; the enemy saw them and thought ambush troops were rising; the pursuit halted.

units.zh: 久之復戰，王師又退，李守超以數百騎短兵直起擊之，敵稍卻。
units.en: Fighting resumed and the imperial line fell back again until Li Shouchao led several hundred horsemen in a close-quarters charge that pushed the enemy back.
units.literal: After a long while they fought again; the imperial army retreated again; Li Shouchao with several hundred horsemen closed with short weapons and charged straight at them; the enemy fell back slightly.

units.zh: 戰場之地，人馬死者無算，斷箭殘鏃，橫厚數寸。
units.en: Men and horses lay dead beyond count; broken shafts and spent arrowheads carpeted the ground inches deep.
units.literal: On the battlefield the dead among men and horses were beyond counting; broken arrows and spent bolt-heads lay piled several inches thick.

units.zh: 遇夜，賊擊鉦抽軍而退，夜行三十里而舍焉。
units.en: At nightfall the enemy beat gongs and pulled back, marching thirty li before making camp.
units.literal: When night came the bandits sounded gongs and withdrew the army; they marched thirty li by night and encamped.

units.zh: 護聖指揮使協霸
units.en: Guardian Sage commander Xie Ba
units.literal: Guardian Sage Guard commander Xie Ba—

units.zh: 〈（協霸」二字上疑有脫文。）〉
units.en: (Editorial note: text appears missing before the name Xie Ba.)
units.literal: (Text is suspected lost above the two characters "Xie Ba".)

units.zh: 亡入賊中，夷其族。
units.en: He defected to the enemy and his entire clan was wiped out.
units.literal: He fled into the enemy ranks and his clan was exterminated.

units.zh: 護聖第二軍都指揮使安重懷、指揮使烏韓七、監軍何彥超等臨陣畏怯，手失兵仗，悉斬之。
units.en: An Chonghuai, overall commander of the Second Army of the Guardian Sage Guard; commander Wu Hanqi; army supervisor He Yanchao and others panicked in battle and dropped their weapons—all were executed.
units.literal: An Chonghuai, overall commander of the second army of the Guardian Sage Guard; commander Wu Hanqi; military inspector He Yanchao and others showed cowardice facing the battle line and let their weapons slip from their hands; all were beheaded.

units.zh: 乙亥，契丹主帳內小校竊其主所乘馬來奔，云：「契丹已傳木書，收軍北去。」
units.en: On yihai a Khitan tent guard stole his lord's horse and defected, reporting, "The Khitan have passed wooden orders to withdraw north."
units.literal: On yihai, a petty officer within the Khitan ruler's tent stole his master's riding horse and came over in surrender, saying: "The Khitan have issued wooden tablets ordering the army to withdraw north."

units.zh: 〈（《契丹國志》云：景延廣疑有詐，閉壁不敢追。
units.en: (Khitan State Chronicle: Jing Yanguang feared a trap and shut the walls, refusing to pursue.
units.literal: (Khitan State Chronicle: Jing Yanguang suspected a ruse and closed the gates, daring not pursue.

units.zh: 遼帝北歸，所過焚掠民物殆盡。）〉
units.en: The Liao emperor marched north, burning and looting everything in his path until little remained.)
units.literal: The Liao emperor returned north; wherever he passed he burned and plundered the people's goods nearly to exhaustion.)

units.zh: 齊州奏，青州賊軍寇明水鎮。
units.en: Qi reported Qingzhou rebel troops raiding Mingshui town.
units.literal: Qizhou memorialized that bandit troops from Qingzhou raided Mingshui town.

units.zh: 壬午，禮部尚書盧詹卒，贈太子太保。
units.en: On renwu Minister of Rites Lu Zhan died and was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: On renwu, Lu Zhan, Minister of Rites, died and was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 甲申，契丹車帳已過貝州，以趙延昭守貝州。
units.en: On jiashen the Khitan royal train had passed Beizhou, leaving Zhao Yanzhao to hold the city.
units.literal: On jiashen, the Khitan royal camp had already passed Beizhou; Zhao Yanzhao was left to hold Beizhou.

units.zh: 〈（《遼史》：三月壬午，留趙延昭守貝州，徙所俘戶於內地。）〉
units.en: (History of Liao: Third month, renwu—Zhao Yanzhao was left at Beizhou and captives were moved inland.)
units.literal: (History of Liao: In the third month on renwu, Zhao Yanzhao was left to hold Beizhou and captured households were relocated to the interior.)

units.zh: 辛卯，定州馬全節攻泰州，拔之，俘其兵士二千人，雜畜戎仗稱是。
units.en: On xinmao Dingzhou's Ma Quanjie took Taizhou, capturing two thousand soldiers plus livestock and arms in proportion.
units.literal: On xinmao, Ma Quanjie of Dingzhou attacked Taizhou and took it; two thousand of its soldiers were captured, along with miscellaneous livestock and weapons in comparable numbers.

units.zh: 癸巳，北京留守、兼中書令劉知遠封太原王，餘如故。
units.en: On guisi Northern Capital garrison commander Liu Zhiyuan, also Grand Councilor, was enfeoffed King of Taiyuan; other titles unchanged.
units.literal: On guisi, Liu Zhiyuan, garrison commander of the Northern Capital and concurrent Grand Councilor, was enfeoffed as King of Taiyuan; the rest unchanged.

units.zh: 是日，詔天下抽點鄉兵，凡七戶出一士，六戶資之，仍自具兵仗，以「武定」為軍號。
units.en: That day an edict levied militia empire-wide: one man from every seven households, supported by six others, armed at their own expense, under the designation "Wuding".
units.literal: That day an edict ordered conscription of militia throughout the realm: one soldier from every seven households, with six households supplying him; they were still to provide their own weapons; "Wuding" was the army designation.

units.zh: 太常丞王緒棄市。
units.en: Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices Wang Xu was executed publicly.
units.literal: Wang Xu, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was executed in the marketplace.

units.zh: 緒家於青州，常致書於楊光遠，緒有妾之兄慊緒不為赒給，遂告與光遠連謀，密書述朝廷機事，遂收捕斬之。
units.en: Xu, whose family was in Qingzhou, had been writing to Yang Guangyuan; his concubine's brother, angry at being denied aid, accused him of plotting with Guangyuan and leaking court secrets; Xu was arrested and beheaded.
units.literal: Xu's family was in Qingzhou; he regularly sent letters to Yang Guangyuan; an elder brother of Xu's concubine resented that Xu did not provide relief and reported that he was in collusion with Guangyuan, with secret letters describing court secrets; he was arrested and beheaded.

units.zh: 夏四月，車駕在澶州。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer the emperor was at Chuanzhou.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer the imperial carriage was at Chuanzhou.

units.zh: 滄州奏，契丹陷德州，刺史尹居璠為敵所執。
units.en: Cang reported the Khitan had captured Dezhou and taken Prefect Yin Jufan.
units.literal: Cangzhou memorialized that the Khitan had taken Dezhou; Prefect Yin Jufan was seized by the enemy.

units.zh: 甲辰，鄴都留守張從恩來朝。
units.en: On jiachen Yedu garrison commander Zhang Congen came to court.
units.literal: On jiachen, Zhang Congen, garrison commander of Yedu, came to court.

units.zh: 丁未，加從恩平章事，還鄴。
units.en: On dingwei Congen was made Grand Councilor and sent back to Ye.
units.literal: On dingwei, Congen was added as Grand Councilor and returned to Ye.

units.zh: 己酉，詔取今月八日車駕還京，令高行周、王周留鎮澶淵，近地兵馬委便宜制置。
units.en: On jiyou an edict fixed the eighth of the month for the emperor's return; Gao Xingzhou and Wang Zhou were left to garrison Chan-Yuan with local forces under their discretion.
units.literal: On jiyou, an edict set the eighth day of this month for the imperial carriage to return to the capital; Gao Xingzhou and Wang Zhou were ordered to remain garrisoning Chan-Yuan; nearby troops and horses were entrusted to discretionary disposition.

units.zh: 甲寅，至自澶州，曲赦京城大辟以下罪人。
units.en: On jiayin the emperor returned from Chuanzhou and granted a limited amnesty in the capital for all but capital crimes.
units.literal: On jiayin, the emperor returned from Chuanzhou and issued a partial amnesty in the capital for crimes below capital punishment.

units.zh: 丁巳，升冀州為防禦使額。
units.en: On dingsi Ji Prefecture was elevated to a defense command.
units.literal: On dingsi, Jizhou was raised to defense commissioner status.

units.zh: 同、華奏，人民相食。
units.en: Tong and Hua reported cannibalism among the people.
units.literal: Tong and Hua memorialized that the people were eating one another.

units.zh: 己未，以右武衛上將軍張彥澤為右神武統軍。
units.en: On jiwei Right Martial Guard senior general Zhang Yanzhe was appointed commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard.
units.literal: On jiwei, Zhang Yanzhe, senior general of the Right Martial Guard, was made commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard.

units.zh: 辛酉，以鄆州節度使、侍衛親軍都指揮使景延廣為西京留守；
units.en: On xinyou Yun commissioner and Palace Guard commander Jing Yanguang was made Western Capital garrison commander;
units.literal: On xinyou, Jing Yanguang, military commissioner of Yunzhou and overall commander of the Palace Guard, was made garrison commander of the Western Capital;

units.zh: 以宋州節度使高行周為侍衛親軍都指揮使；
units.en: Song commissioner Gao Xingzhou was made Palace Guard commander;
units.literal: Gao Xingzhou, military commissioner of Songzhou, was made overall commander of the Palace Guard;

units.zh: 以侍衛親軍都虞候、義成軍節度使李守貞為兗州節度使，典軍如故。
units.en: Palace Guard deputy Li Shouzhen, also Yicheng commissioner, was transferred to Yanzhou while keeping his army command.
units.literal: Li Shouzhen, deputy commander of the Palace Guard and military commissioner of Yicheng Army, was made military commissioner of Yanzhou, continuing to command troops as before.

units.zh: 是日，分命文武臣僚三十六人往諸道州府括率錢帛，以次軍用。
units.en: That day thirty-six officials were sent to circuits and prefectures to levy money and cloth for the army in rotation.
units.literal: That day thirty-six civil and military officials were separately dispatched to the various circuits, prefectures, and districts to requisition money and silk for military expenses in turn.

units.zh: 癸亥，以西京留守安彥威為晉昌軍節度使，以晉昌軍節度使趙瑩為華州節度使，以左龍武統軍皇甫遇為滑州節度使。
units.en: On guihai Western Capital garrison commander An Yanwei became Jinchang commissioner; Jinchang commissioner Zhao Ying became commissioner of Huazhou; Left Dragon Martial commander Huangfu Yu became commissioner of Hua Prefecture.
units.literal: On guihai, An Yanwei, garrison commander of the Western Capital, was made military commissioner of Jinchang Army; Zhao Ying, military commissioner of Jinchang Army, was made military commissioner of Huazhou; Huangfu Yu, commander of the Left Dragon Martial Guard, was made military commissioner of Hua Prefecture.

units.zh: 是日，置酒宮中，召景延廣謂之曰：「卿有佐命之功，命保釐伊、洛，非酬勛之地也。」
units.en: That day the emperor feasted Jing Yanguang in the palace and said, "You helped establish the dynasty; posting you to guard Yi and Luo is no mere reward for merit."
units.literal: That day wine was set out in the palace; Jing Yanguang was summoned and told: "You have merit in aiding the founding mandate; assigning you to safeguard Yi and Luo is not a place to reward achievement."

units.zh: 因解禦衣、寶帶以賜之。
units.en: He then gave Yanguang his own robe and jeweled belt.
units.literal: Thereupon the emperor removed his imperial robe and precious belt and bestowed them.

units.zh: 丙寅，隴州奏，餓死者五萬六千口。
units.en: On bingyin Long reported fifty-six thousand dead from famine.
units.literal: On bingyin, Longzhou memorialized that fifty-six thousand had died of starvation.

units.zh: 五月壬申朔，太原劉知遠奏，邊境未寧，軍用甚廣，所封王爵，乞未行冊命。
units.en: On the first day renshen of the fifth month Taiyuan's Liu Zhiyuan asked to defer his royal investiture, citing an unsettled frontier and crushing military costs.
units.literal: On the first day renshen of the fifth month, Liu Zhiyuan of Taiyuan memorialized that the border was not yet settled, military expenses were very heavy, and regarding the enfeoffment as king he begged that the investiture ceremony not yet be carried out.

units.zh: 戊寅，遣侍衛親軍都虞候李守貞率步騎二萬，討楊光遠於青州。
units.en: On wuyin Palace Guard deputy Li Shouzhen was dispatched with twenty thousand foot and horse to crush Yang Guangyuan at Qingzhou.
units.literal: On wuyin, Li Shouzhen, deputy commander of the Palace Guard, was sent to lead twenty thousand infantry and cavalry to campaign against Yang Guangyuan at Qingzhou.

units.zh: 丁亥，以鄴都留守張從恩為貝州行營都部署，
units.en: On dinghai Yedu garrison commander Zhang Congen was named overall Beizhou camp commander,
units.literal: On dinghai, Zhang Congen, garrison commander of Yedu, was made overall camp commander at Beizhou,

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：張從恩上言：「趙延昭雖據貝州，麾下將士久客思歸，宜速進軍攻擊。」
units.en: (Zizhi Tongjian: Zhang Congen argued, "Zhao Yanzhao holds Beizhou, but his troops are homesick after long service abroad—we should attack at once."
units.literal: (Zizhi Tongjian: Zhang Congen submitted: "Although Zhao Yanzhao holds Beizhou, the officers and soldiers under him, long absent as guests, yearn to return home; we ought to advance quickly and attack."

units.zh: 詔以從恩為貝州行營都部署。）〉
units.en: An edict appointed Congen Beizhou camp commander.)
units.literal: An edict made Congen overall camp commander at Beizhou.)

units.zh: 以滑州節度使皇甫遇為行營都虞候，以左神武統軍潘環掌騎兵，右神武統軍張彥澤掌步兵。
units.en: Hua commissioner Huangfu Yu became deputy camp commander; Left Divine Martial commander Pan Huan took the cavalry; Right Divine Martial commander Zhang Yanzhe took the infantry.
units.literal: Huangfu Yu, military commissioner of Hua Prefecture, was made deputy camp commander; Pan Huan, commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard, was put in charge of cavalry; Zhang Yanzhe, commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard, was put in charge of infantry.

units.zh: 辛卯，張從恩奏，貝州賊將趙延昭縱火大掠，棄城而遁。
units.en: On xinmao Zhang Congen reported Zhao Yanzhao burning and looting Beizhou before abandoning the city.
units.literal: On xinmao, Zhang Congen memorialized that the Beizhou bandit general Zhao Yanzhao set fires and plundered heavily, then abandoned the city and fled.

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：延昭屯於瀛、莫，阻水自固。）〉
units.en: (Zizhi Tongjian: Yanzhao withdrew to Ying and Mo and fortified himself behind the water.)
units.literal: (Zizhi Tongjian: Yanzhao encamped at Ying and Mo, blocking the water to hold firm.)

units.zh: 以李守貞為青州行營都部署，以河陽節度使符彥卿副之。
units.en: Li Shouzhen was made Qingzhou theater commander with Heyang commissioner Fu Yanqing as his deputy.
units.literal: Li Shouzhen was made overall Qingzhou camp commander; Fu Yanqing, military commissioner of Heyang, was made his deputy.

units.zh: 戊戌，以鄧州節度使何建為貝州永清軍節度使。
units.en: On wuxu Deng commissioner He Jian was made Yongqing Army commissioner at Beizhou.
units.literal: On wuxu, He Jian, military commissioner of Dengzhou, was made military commissioner of Yongqing Army at Beizhou.

units.zh: 是月，澤潞上言，餓死者凡五千餘人。
units.en: That month Ze and Lu reported more than five thousand famine deaths.
units.literal: That month Ze and Lu reported that over five thousand had died of starvation.

units.zh: 六月辛丑朔，王師拔淄州，斬楊光遠偽署刺史劉翰。
units.en: On the first day xinchou of the sixth month the imperial army captured Zizhou and executed Liu Han, Yang Guangyuan's puppet prefect.
units.literal: On the first day xinchou of the sixth month, the imperial army took Zizhou and beheaded Liu Han, Yang Guangyuan's appointee as prefect.

units.zh: 癸卯，以太尉、兼侍中馮道為檢校太師、兼侍中，充同州節度使。
units.en: On guimao Grand Marshal Feng Dao was made honorary Grand Preceptor and Tong commissioner, retaining his Palace Secretary title.
units.literal: On guimao, Feng Dao, Grand Marshal and concurrent Palace Secretary, was made honorary Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Secretary, serving as military commissioner of Tongzhou.

units.zh: 丙午，詔復置樞密院。
units.en: On bingwu an edict re-established the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: On bingwu, an edict restored the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 丁未，以侍中桑維翰為中書令，充樞密使。
units.en: On dingwei Palace Secretary Sang Weihan became Grand Councilor and Commissioner of Military Affairs.
units.literal: On dingwei, Sang Weihan, Palace Secretary, was made Grand Councilor and served as Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 權開封府尹李周卒，輟朝，贈太師。
units.en: Acting Kaifeng mayor Li Zhou died; court was suspended and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: Li Zhou, acting mayor of Kaifeng, died; court audience was suspended; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 辛亥，以邢州節度使安叔千為晉州節度使，加同平章事；
units.en: On xinhai Xing commissioner An Shuqian was made Jin commissioner and appointed Grand Councilor;
units.literal: On xinhai, An Shuqian, military commissioner of Xingzhou, was made military commissioner of Jinzhou and given the additional title of Grand Councilor;

units.zh: 以晉州節度使宋彥筠為陜州節度使；
units.en: Jin commissioner Song Yanyun was transferred to Shaan;
units.literal: Song Yanyun, military commissioner of Jinzhou, was made military commissioner of Shaanzhou;

units.zh: 以吏部郎中李穀充樞密直學士。
units.en: Personnel bureau director Li Gu was made direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: Li Gu, bureau director in the Ministry of Personnel, was made direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 丙辰，滑州河決，漂註曹、單、濮、鄆等州之境，環梁山合於汶、濟。
units.en: On bingchen the Yellow River broke through at Hua, inundating Cao, Dan, Pu, Yun, and neighboring prefectures; the flood wrapped around Mount Liang and merged with the Wen and Ji.
units.literal: On bingchen, the Yellow River burst its banks at Huazhou, flooding and pouring into the territories of Cao, Dan, Pu, Yun, and other prefectures, circling Mount Liang and joining the Wen and Ji rivers.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·楊昭儉傳》：河決數郡，大發丁夫，以本部帥董其役，既而塞之。
units.en: (History of Song, Biography of Yang Zhaojian: The breach affected several commanderies; mass corvée was levied under the local commander, and the breach was eventually closed.
units.literal: (History of Song, Biography of Yang Zhaojian: The river burst in several commanderies; corvée laborers were levied on a great scale; the commander of the local circuit supervised the work, and afterward it was sealed.

units.zh: 晉少主喜，詔立碑紀其事。
units.en: Emperor Shao of Jin was pleased and ordered a monument erected to commemorate it.
units.literal: The Young Lord of Jin was pleased and ordered a stele erected to record the affair.

units.zh: 昭儉表諫曰：「陛下刻石紀功，不若降哀痛之詔；
units.en: Zhaojian remonstrated: "Your Majesty, a stone monument to merit is less fitting than an edict of mourning and repentance;
units.literal: Zhaojian memorialized in remonstrance, saying: "Your Majesty, to carve stone recording merit is not as good as issuing an edict of mourning and pain;

units.zh: 摛翰頌美，不若頒罪己之文。」
units.en: literary praise is less fitting than proclaiming a confession of your own errors."
units.literal: to wield the brush in praise is not as good as promulgating a text confessing fault."

units.zh: 言甚切至，少主嗟賞之，卒罷其事。）〉
units.en: His words were forceful; Emperor Shao admired them and dropped the plan.)
units.literal: His words were very earnest; the Young Lord sighed in admiration and finally abandoned the matter.)

units.zh: 戊午，升府州為團練使額。
units.en: On wuwu Fu Prefecture was raised to regimental commissioner rank.
units.literal: On wuwu, Fuzhou was elevated to regimental commissioner status.

units.zh: 庚申，襄州獻白鵲。
units.en: On gengshen Xiang Prefecture presented a white magpie.
units.literal: On gengshen, Xiangzhou presented a white magpie.

units.zh: 甲子，復置翰林學士。
units.en: On jiazi the office of Hanlin academician was restored.
units.literal: On jiazi, Hanlin academicians were reinstated.

units.zh: 乙丑，宰臣等三上表請聽樂，詔允之。
units.en: On yichou the chief ministers submitted three memorials asking to resume court music; the emperor approved.
units.literal: On yichou, the chief ministers and others thrice submitted memorials requesting permission to hear music; an edict granted it.

units.zh: 戊辰，以門下侍郎王松為左丞；
units.en: On wuchen Chancellery Vice Director Wang Song was made Left Vice Director;
units.literal: On wuchen, Wang Song, Vice Director of the Chancellery, was made Left Vice Director;

units.zh: 以右丞王易簡為吏部侍郎；
units.en: Right Vice Director Wang Yijian was made Vice Minister of Personnel;
units.literal: Wang Yijian, Right Vice Director, was made Vice Minister of Personnel;

units.zh: 以右散騎常侍蕭願為秘書監；
units.en: Right Cavalry Attendant Xiao Yuan was made Director of the Imperial Library;
units.literal: Xiao Yuan, Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Director of the Imperial Library;

units.zh: 以右諫議大夫王仁裕為給事中；
units.en: Right Remonstrance Grandee Wang Renyu was made Supervising Secretary;
units.literal: Wang Renyu, Right Remonstrance Grandee, was made Supervising Secretary;

units.zh: 以給事中李式為左散騎常侍；
units.en: Supervising Secretary Li Shi was made Left Cavalry Attendant;
units.literal: Li Shi, Supervising Secretary, was made Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry;

units.zh: 以金部郎中、知制誥徐臺符為翰林學士；
units.en: Revenue bureau director and edict drafter Xu Taifu was made Hanlin academician;
units.literal: Xu Taifu, bureau director in the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of edicts, was made Hanlin academician;

units.zh: 以禮部郎中李浣本官知制誥，充翰林學士；
units.en: Rites bureau director Li Huan kept his rank, was made edict drafter, and appointed Hanlin academician;
units.literal: Li Huan, bureau director in the Ministry of Rites, retained his office and served as drafter of edicts, filling the post of Hanlin academician;

units.zh: 以刑部郎中劉溫叟改都官郎中，充翰林學士；
units.en: Justice bureau director Liu Wensou was moved to director of the Bureau of Capital Officials and made Hanlin academician;
units.literal: Liu Wensou, bureau director in the Ministry of Justice, was transferred to bureau director of the Capital Officials and filled the post of Hanlin academician;

units.zh: 以主客員外郎範質充翰林學士；
units.en: Receptions assistant director Fan Zhi was made Hanlin academician;
units.literal: Fan Zhi, assistant director in the Ministry of Receptions, was made Hanlin academician;

units.zh: 御史張宜改倉部員外郎、知制誥。
units.en: Censor Zhang Yi was made assistant director in the Ministry of Granaries and edict drafter.
units.literal: Censor Zhang Yi was transferred to assistant director in the Ministry of Granaries and made drafter of edicts.

units.zh: 庚午，以前晉州節度使周密為左龍武統軍，以同州節度使李懷忠為左羽林統軍。
units.en: On gengwu former Jin commissioner Zhou Mi was appointed commander of the Left Dragon Martial Guard, and Tong commissioner Li Huaizhong commander of the Left Feathered Forest Guard.
units.literal: On gengwu, Zhou Mi, former military commissioner of Jinzhou, was made commander of the Left Dragon Martial Guard; Li Huaizhong, military commissioner of Tongzhou, was made commander of the Left Feathered Forest Guard.

units.zh: 翰林學士、中書舍人和凝為工部侍郎，並依前充職。
units.en: He Ning, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafter, was made Vice Minister of Works—all retaining their concurrent posts as before.
units.literal: He Ning, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafter, was made Vice Minister of Works—all retaining their concurrent posts as before.

units.zh: 壬午，以翰林學士承旨、戶部侍郎程遂為兵部侍郎；
units.en: On renwu Cheng Sui, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War;
units.literal: On renwu, Cheng Sui, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War;

units.zh: 國子博士田敏請葺四郊祠祭齋室。
units.en: Libationer Tian Min asked to repair the suburban sacrifice fasting halls.
units.literal: National University libationer Tian Min requested repair of the suburban sacrifice fasting chambers.

units.zh: 昭義節度使、侍衛馬軍都指揮使、廣晉府行營都排陣使杜重威，河陽節度使兼奉國左右廂都指揮使、廣晉府行營馬步都虞候侯益，並加檢校太傅。
units.en: Du Chongwei, military commissioner of Zhaoyi, cavalry commander of the palace guard, and chief array marshal of the Guangjin headquarters, and Hou Yi, military commissioner of Heyang, commander of the Fengguo wings, and horse-and-foot chief adjutant of the Guangjin headquarters, were both made honorary grand mentors.
units.literal: Du Chongwei—Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi, Commander of the Palace Guard Cavalry, and Chief Array Marshal of the Guangjin Field Headquarters—and Hou Yi—Military Commissioner of Heyang, Commander of the Left and Right Wings of the Fengguo Army, and Horse and Foot Chief Adjutant of the Guangjin Field Headquarters—were both promoted to Honorary Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 甲申，以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、寧國軍節度使安彥威為河中節度使；
units.en: On jiashen An Yanwei, commander of the imperial cavalry and commissioner of the Ningguo Army, was made commissioner of Hezhong;
units.literal: On jiashen Commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry, Ningguo Army military commissioner An Yanwei was made Hezhong military commissioner;

units.zh: 以侍衛步軍都指揮使、忠正軍節度使張從賓為涇州節度使，並加檢校太傅；
units.en: Zhang Congbin, commander of the imperial infantry and commissioner of the Zhongzheng Army, was made commissioner of Jingzhou; both were advanced honorary Grand Mentor;
units.literal: Commander of the Imperial Guard infantry, Zhongzheng Army military commissioner Zhang Congbin was made Jingzhou military commissioner, both advanced honorary Grand Mentor;

units.zh: 契丹寇澶州，以臨陣忸怩，為景延廣所誅。
units.en: When the Khitan attacked Chanzhou he shrank from the fight and was executed by Jing Yanguang.
units.literal: When the Khitan raided Chanzhou he hesitated before the battle line and was executed by Jing Yanguang.

units.zh: 丙申，以威勝軍節度副使羅周嶽為給事中，中書舍人李詳改禮部侍郎，禮部侍郎呂琦改刑部侍郎，刑部侍郎王松改戶部侍郎，戶部侍郎閻至改兵部侍郎，中書舍人王易簡充史館修撰，判館事。
units.en: On the bingshen day, Luo Zhouyue was appointed supervising secretary; Li Xiang became vice minister of rites; Lü Qi, vice minister of justice; Wang Song, vice minister of revenue; Yan Zhi, vice minister of war; and Wang Yijian, compiler of the Historiography Institute, was placed in charge of its affairs.
units.literal: On the bingshen day, Luo Zhouyue, Deputy Military Governor of the Weisheng Army, was appointed Supervising Secretary; Li Xiang, Secretariat Drafter, was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites; Lü Qi, Vice Minister of Rites, to Vice Minister of Justice; Wang Song, Vice Minister of Justice, to Vice Minister of Revenue; Yan Zhi, Vice Minister of Revenue, to Vice Minister of War; and Wang Yijian, Secretariat Drafter, was made Compiler of the Historiography Institute and administered its affairs.

units.zh: 以夏州行軍司馬李彝殷為本州節度使，兄彝超卒故也。
units.en: Li Yiyin, Xiazhou campaigning deputy, was made commander of that prefecture after his elder brother Yichao died.
units.literal: Li Yiyin, campaigning deputy of Xia Prefecture, was made military commissioner of that prefecture, because his elder brother Yichao had died.

units.zh: 以嚴衛左右廂都指揮使、岩州刺史皇甫遇為忠正軍節度使、檢校太保，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。
units.en: Huangfu Yu, commander of the left and right wings of the Strict Guard and prefect of Yanzhou, was made commissioner of the Zhongzheng Army and honorary Grand Guardian, and appointed commander of the imperial infantry.
units.literal: Commander of the left and right wings of the Strict Guard, Yanzhou prefect Huangfu Yu was made Zhongzheng Army military commissioner and honorary Grand Guardian, and appointed Commander of the Imperial Guard infantry.

units.zh: 以澶州防禦使張從恩為樞密副使。
units.en: Zhang Cong'en, defense commissioner of Chan Prefecture, was appointed vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: Zhang Cong'en, Defense Commissioner of Chan Prefecture, was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 樞密院學士、尚書倉部郎中司徒詡，樞密院學士、尚書工部郎中顏衎並落職守本官，樞密副使張從恩改宣徽使：初廢樞密院故也。
units.en: Situ Xu and Yan Kan, academicians of the Bureau of Military Affairs, were stripped of their concurrent posts and retained their original offices; Zhang Cong'en, vice commissioner of the bureau, was reassigned as commissioner of the Palace Directorate—because the Bureau of Military Affairs had just been abolished.
units.literal: Situ Xu, Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Granary Section of the Ministry of Revenue, and Yan Kan, Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Works Section of the Ministry of Works, were both removed from their posts and retained their original offices; Zhang Cong'en, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was changed to Commissioner of the Palace Directorate—because the Bureau of Military Affairs was first abolished.

units.zh: 吳巒，字寶川，汶陽盧縣人也。
units.en: Wu Luan, styled Baochuan, was from Lu County in Wenyang.
units.literal: Wu Luan, styled Baochuan, was a native of Lu County in Wenyang.

units.zh: 時巒在城中，謂其眾曰：「豈有禮義之人而臣於異姓乎！」
units.en: At the time Luan was in the city and said to his followers, "How can a man of ritual and righteousness serve an alien ruler!"
units.literal: At the time Luan was in the city and said to his masses, "How can there be a man of ritual and righteousness who serves an alien surname!"

units.zh: 召巒歸闕，授徐州節度使，再遷右諫議大夫，為復州防禦使，數年罷歸。
units.en: Luan was summoned back to court and appointed military governor of Xu prefecture; he was transferred again to Right Grand Master of Remonstrance and served as defense commissioner of Fu prefecture; after several years he was dismissed and returned.
units.literal: Luan was summoned back to court and appointed military governor of Xu Prefecture; he was transferred again to Right Grand Master of Remonstrance and served as defense commissioner of Fu Prefecture; after several years he was dismissed and returned.

units.zh: 及令溫入朝，執政者以巒雲中之難，有善守之功，遂令乘軺而往，權知貝州軍州事。
units.en: When Lingwen entered court, the administrators, because Luan had endured the hardship at Yunzhong and had the merit of good defense, therefore ordered him to go by light carriage and provisionally govern the military and civil affairs of Bei prefecture.
units.literal: When Lingwen entered court, the administrators, because Luan had the hardship at Yunzhong and the merit of good defense, therefore ordered him to go by light carriage and provisionally govern the military and civil affairs of Bei Prefecture.

units.zh: 邵珂一見，因求自效，即聽而任之。
units.en: At first sight Shao Ke therefore requested to serve at his own initiative; Luan heard him and entrusted him with the task.
units.literal: At first sight Shao Ke therefore requested to serve at his own initiative; he was heard and entrusted with the task.

units.zh: 巒素為書生，旁無爪牙，珂慷慨自陳，願效死左右，巒遣督義兵，守城之南門。
